description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 299. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. Blocks 0 to 99 have a complete chain. Blocks 100 to 199 have pages 0 and 2 but page 1 is missing, so that chain is broken: the range is not covered and its events (a release, a duplicate of it, an open, an unfinalized open, a malformed event and a refund) count nowhere (clause 1). Blocks 200 to 299 have no pages at all. The census is partial and every total is labeled partial. Expected: complete false, status partial; covered 0 to 99; gaps 100 to 299; totals escrows_opened 2, escrows_released 0, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 0; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1), synthetic-bob (escrows_opened 1).
